title: lupinus lepidus subsp. aridus
intro: Lupinus lepidus subsp. aridus, commonly known as the desert lupine, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the lupin family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Lupinus lepidus subsp. aridus include antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
